title: A new account's CDK bootstrap and hosted zones have no repeatable setup
description: Left open by PPY-9d1b3e. infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh makes the pipeline roles and GitHub connection repeatable, and infra/pipeline/README.md lists the order for a new account, but nothing creates the CDK bootstrap (its assets bucket) or the public hosted zones the stacks look up, today anth.us, and SES sandbox exit is a request to AWS. The first-create path of papyrus-monitoring on an empty account is tested against a fake only and has never been rehearsed on a real empty account. Ryan's rule: nothing about setting up an account may be local knowledge.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope note from PPY-9d1b3e / PR #1226: the approval-gated role-stack-deploy workflow covers only the papyrus-stack-pipeline stack. infra/scheduled-jobs, papyrus-procedure-runner, edge and per-site newsletter stacks are NOT in that PR; this ticket takes them.
